newsitem.title: USA: IMM CURRENCIES END MIXED,YEN CLIMBS SHARPLY HIGHER.
newsitem.headline: IMM CURRENCIES END MIXED,YEN CLIMBS SHARPLY HIGHER.

text.p: Aug 8 - IMM currency futures ended mixed, with yen climbing sharply higher as funds liquidated long dollar positions. Sept marks and Swiss francs also rallied, while sterling remained weak. Traders said Sept marks are still in a long-term downtrend. Can dollars were lower, but pesos recovered losses. ((Chicago Derivatives Desk (312)408-8750))
